data.name: King Crab
data.detailed_description:
King Crab is a physics-driven beach defense game where you reshape the sand to protect your crab’s castle from the ocean. Dig trenches, pile up walls, and redirect waves as they crash toward your defenses. Each round the water grows stronger, the storms get nastier, and your castle is pushed closer to washing away.

Explore different beaches filled with unpredictable water, wildlife, hidden items, flooding houses, and ridiculous physics-driven chaos. Ride boats, surf the waves, throw objects around, dodge sharks, and deal with humans and animals trying to wreck your castle.

Roam off the main path between waves to uncover tools and surprises that give you new ways to defend. What you discover might be the thing that saves your crab when the next storm rolls in.

Play on PC or step inside the action in VR, both included for one price. Either way, every scoop of sand, every wall you build, and every desperate last-second trench could be the difference between saving the castle or watching it wash away.

Features

  • Reshape the beach by digging trenches and building sand walls

  • Redirect waves, storms, and floodwater away from your crab’s castle

  • Protect the crab across multiple beach levels with different layouts, music, and hazards

  • Explore between waves to find hidden tools, items, and surprises

  • Ride boats, surf, swim, and mess around with physics objects

  • Encounter fish, sharks, squid, crabs, humans, and other beach chaos

  • Play on PC or in VR with one purchase

  • Face unpredictable waves where no round plays exactly the same

data.short_description: Dig trenches, build sand walls, and redirect waves to protect King Crab’s castle. Explore chaotic beaches, ride boats, surf, and defend against the rising tide -- on PC or in VR.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Core i5-7500 / Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard or better
  • VR Support: SteamVR, OpenXR. Supports Valve Index, HTC Vive, Oculus Rift, Oculus Quest (via Link/Air Link). Full support for Index Controllers, Vive Wands, Oculus Touch.
  • Additional Notes: Room-scale VR is recommended for the best experience when playing in VR mode.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard or better
  • VR Support: SteamVR, OpenXR. Supports Valve Index, HTC Vive, Oculus Rift, Oculus Quest (via Link/Air Link). Full support for Index Controllers, Vive Wands, Oculus Touch.
  • Additional Notes: Room-scale VR is recommended for the best experience when playing in VR mode.
